correctness.rationale: For unnormalized g_{a,b}, Zak diagonalization at translation 1/modulation 1/2 yields F=|Zg(x,w)|^2+|Zg(x,w+1/2)|^2. The explicit even/odd terms produce a positive numerator increasing in cos(4 pi w) over strictly decreasing positive denominator terms. Thus phase minima/maxima at w=1/4,0. The upper fiber is a strictly convex positive sum of exponentials, maximized at identified endpoints; the lower fiber is 2(p e^{-2a x}+h e^{2b x}-2q e^{(b-a)x}), whose derivative has a single positive quadratic root. The determinant p h-q^2=s^2(1-rs)^2/[(1+r^2)^2(1+s^2)^2]>0 ensures strict positivity. Independent 150-case formula comparisons and direct truncated Zak series checks match the previous October 26 theorem, so correctness and decisive coverage are distinct findings.
